THE_GUARDIAN.name: THE GUARDIAN
THE_GUARDIAN.subtitle: The Guardian
THE_GUARDIAN.description: You protect the relationship with fierce loyalty and caution, though striving to keep control can inadvertently create emotional distance.

THE_SEEKER.name: THE SEEKER
THE_SEEKER.subtitle: The Truth Seeker
THE_SEEKER.description: You value honesty, deep intimacy, and utter clarity. You are unafraid to ask difficult questions to reach raw truth.

THE_ANCHOR.name: THE ANCHOR
THE_ANCHOR.subtitle: The Grounded Anchor
THE_ANCHOR.description: A pillar of trust, forgiveness, and quiet resilience. You are committed to being a reliable safe harbor.

THE_MIRROR.name: THE MIRROR
THE_MIRROR.subtitle: The Empathic Mirror
THE_MIRROR.description: You absorb and mirror the subtle emotional shifts of your partner, deeply attuned to every unspoken glance.

THE_FREE_SOUL.name: THE FREE SOUL
THE_FREE_SOUL.subtitle: The Free Soul
THE_FREE_SOUL.description: You treasure genuine connection while needing emotional room to breathe and preserve your individuality.

THE_WALL.name: THE WALL
THE_WALL.subtitle: The Protective Wall
THE_WALL.description: Built from past hurt, your emotional walls shield you from pain. Silence and distance become your instinctive shelter.

THE_HEALER.name: THE HEALER
THE_HEALER.subtitle: The Restorative Healer
THE_HEALER.description: Empathetic and forgiving, you instinctively nurture broken pieces and hold gentle space for emotional restoration.

THE_FIRE.name: THE FIRE
THE_FIRE.subtitle: The Passionate Fire
THE_FIRE.description: Intense, expressive, and unhesitating. You bring incandescent passion and unfiltered honesty into the connection.
